_comment: Baseline of Tuas Power figures as verified 24 Aug 2026 against Tuas's own factsheets and campaign pages. The tripwire compares live values against this file. When a change is confirmed and the site is updated, update this file too — otherwise the tripwire keeps firing on the same change.

factsheet_versions._comment: Tuas encodes date and ex-GST rate in the PDF filename, e.g. powerfix_36_20260803(269.7).pdf = 3 Aug 2026, 26.97c ex-GST. A filename change is the single most reliable repricing signal.
factsheet_versions._bootstrap: A value of "unknown" means: track this plan, but adopt whatever the first run observes and write it back here. Only powerfix_36 was confirmed by hand on 24 Aug 2026 (26.97c ex-GST / 29.40c inc GST, factsheet dated 3 Aug 2026). The rest self-baseline on the first run so the tripwire does not fire forever on plans whose exact filename was never verified.

rates_inc_gst_cents._comment: Tuas Power plans, GST-inclusive, from their 3 Aug 2026 factsheets.

campaign._comment: ONSGDAY26 (National Day, $120/$200, grocery e-voucher option) ENDED 31 Aug 2026 and was replaced on 1 Sep 2026 by ONLINE: $100 on PowerFIX 24, $160 on PowerFIX 36, BILL CREDIT ONLY - no grocery e-voucher - first 500 sign-ups, to 11 Oct 2026. Verified against savewithtuas.com/promotions/ and /promotions/online/, which agree. NOTE: the old warning to ignore /promotions/online/ as a stale July campaign no longer holds - as at 1 Sep 2026 that sub-page matches the promotions index.

pacificlight_reference_inc_gst_cents._comment: PacificLight repriced on 20 Aug 2026 — Savvy Saver 24: 27.50 -> 29.80, Savvy Saver 36: 27.18 -> 29.40 — read from their own factsheets on 24 Aug 2026. Their factsheet LISTING page IS readable and the slugs encode plan+date, so a real PacificLight tripwire is feasible; see pacificlight_discovery in rates-watch.json. Until that is built, these two numbers are maintained by hand.

pacificlight_factsheet_slugs._comment: PacificLight factsheet slugs as recorded by the nightly Action's pacificlight_discovery block on 2026-08-25T22:56Z, matching the hand-verified position of 24 Aug 2026. Each slug encodes plan AND factsheet date. A NEWER date on any tracked slug, or an UNTRACKED slug appearing, means PacificLight has repriced: read https://pacificlight.com.sg/support/factsheet-detail/<slug> for the rate before and after GST. savvy_saver_24 and savvy_saver_36 carry the site's rate claims and matter most. Baselined from the discovery block, NOT re-read by hand on 26 Aug 2026 - scheduled cloud runs cannot reach pacificlight.com.sg.

editorial_position._comment: As at 24 Aug 2026 NO retailer is cheapest on rate: all six sit at 29.80c on 24 months, and PacificLight, Tuas and Senoko are all 29.40c on 36. The site no longer argues PacificLight is cheapest — it argues the rebates and perks decide. An INVERSION now means Tuas becoming strictly cheaper than PacificLight, not merely equal to it.
